name: A Knight in New York
source:
You're tired of the dating scene. At this point, a happy love life may just be a fantasy. But fantasy may find you in unexpected ways.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/A_Knight_in_New_York]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你厌倦了约会场景。此时，幸福的爱情生活或许只是一个幻想。但幻想可能会以意想不到的方式找到你。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/A_Knight_in_New_York]Choices Wikia[/url]]
